    GuidedTutorial
    GuidedTutorial.setPostAction(Runnable postAction)
    Sets a one-off action to run at the end of stop(), once the tutorial's own teardown is done e.g., to undo whatever setPreAction(Runnable) changed.
    GuidedTutorial
    GuidedTutorial.setPreAction(Runnable preAction)
    Sets a one-off action to run at the top of start(), before the first step is shown, e.g. switching the viewer into whatever tracing mode the tutorial expects.
    GuidedTutorial
    GuidedTutorial.setPreAction(Runnable preAction, long settleMs)
    As setPreAction(Runnable), but waits settleMs after running preAction before showing the first step, instead of showing it immediately.
